# Clockitt

> Clockitt is a productivity and accountability app that helps you wake up, set daily goals, stay accountable with a partner, and actually finish what you start. Currently in early access via waitlist.

## Pages

- [Home](https://clockitt.app/): Product overview and waitlist signup.
- [How it works](https://clockitt.app/how-it-works): The four-step Clockitt loop — wake up, set a finish line, check in, close the loop.
- [Accountability partner app](https://clockitt.app/accountability-partner): How Clockitt pairs you with a real person for daily goal check-ins.
- [Privacy](https://clockitt.app/privacy): What waitlist data is collected and how to remove it.
- [Terms](https://clockitt.app/terms): Terms of service and usage guidelines.
